description: The pass-1 fix added Clone to pkix-path::Error and pkix-revocation::Error, but pkix-path-builder::Error (lib.rs:101) was not updated. It derives Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash — but not Clone. This is an inconsistency: all three crate Error types should be Clone so callers can store, log, or propagate errors without consuming them. Fix: add Clone to the derive list at lib.rs:101.
title: pkix-path-builder: Error missing Clone derive (inconsistent with pass-1 Error Clone fix)
